content:
## 十二强争冠赛暨2026社团表演赛

本学期首项重磅赛事——**十二强争冠赛暨2026社团表演赛**来了！

- **比赛时间**：9月10日（星期四）社团课及晚自习前时间
- **参赛选手**：12名选手，按当前积分排定种子，分为A/B/C/D四个小组进行组内单循环
- **赛程与赛制**：已公布，点击查看 → [十二强争冠赛暨2026社团表演赛赛事详情](detail.html?type=competition&id=c6)

简要说明：小组赛于16:30–18:30在1号台、2号台同时进行，每场比赛五局三胜，胜一场计1分、败者不得分，各组积分第一名晋级下一阶段。完整的赛程表、裁判安排与排名规则见赛事详情页。
title_en: Announcement: Top-12 Championship & 2026 Club Exhibition Tournament
excerpt_en: The Top-12 Championship & 2026 Club Exhibition Tournament kicks off on 10 September. The 12 players are seeded by points and play a round robin in four groups; see the Competitions section for the schedule and format.
content_en:
## Top-12 Championship & 2026 Club Exhibition Tournament

The first big event of this term is here — the **Top-12 Championship & 2026 Club Exhibition Tournament**!

- **Date and time**: Thursday 10 September, during club period and before evening self-study
- **Players**: 12 entrants, seeded on current points, split into four groups A/B/C/D playing a round robin within each group
- **Schedule and format**: published — click to view → [Top-12 Championship & 2026 Club Exhibition Tournament details](detail.html?type=competition&id=c6)

In short: the group stage runs from 16:30–18:30 on table 1 and table 2 at the same time. Every match is best of five games; a win is worth 1 point and a loss is worth none. The player on points in each group advances to the next stage. The full schedule, the umpiring arrangements and the ranking rules are on the event details page.

content:

2026年秋季学期新赛季正式开始！

title_en: New Season Begins in the 2026 Autumn Term
excerpt_en: The new season is officially under way: apart from the carried-over points, all statistics such as win rate and matches played are reset and counted afresh; past seasons' data can still be viewed in the personal data visualisation section
content_en:
## New Season Begins

The new season for the 2026 autumn term is officially under way!

- **Points**: points carry over between seasons under the standard rules, continuing from last season's base
- **Statistics reset**: apart from the carried-over points, statistics such as **win rate** and **matches played** are reset to zero and counted afresh
- **Historical data**: earlier seasons' data is not lost — open a player's **data visualisation section** to look it up

A new term, a fresh start — see you all at the tables during club period!

content: 各位社员，鉴于乒乓球社团两片场地的球台、球网和地面均存在不同程度的损坏或安全隐患，借学校翻新之机，社团管理层已完成社团场地改进申请书的起草并已于8.5(昨日)晚些时候发送至学校的相关校领导。我们拟购进一张新球桌以替换两个断腿的半台，以旧换新八张球网，并在两片场地的地面上铺设防滑地胶。目前，黄志刚老师已回复表示改进申请合理可行，并指示我们进一步联系下学期专门负责管理社团的翟苏敏老师。我们将密切关注最新情况，与校方共同制定具体方案，并及时将最新进展告知各位社员。场地改进可能需要在开学后进行，场地可能会因此停用一小段时间，若给您带来不便，敬请谅解！
title_en: The Club Officers Are Moving Ahead With Improvements to the Playing Area
excerpt_en: Dear members, the tables, nets and floor of the club's two playing areas are all damaged to varying degrees, or present safety hazards. Taking the opportunity of the school's renovation, the club officers have finished drafting the application for improvements to the playing area and sent it to the relevant school leaders late on 5 August (yesterday). We plan to buy… (click for details)
content_en: Dear members, the tables, nets and floor of the club's two playing areas are all damaged to varying degrees, or present safety hazards. Taking the opportunity of the school's renovation, the club officers have finished drafting the application for improvements to the playing area and sent it to the relevant school leaders late on 5 August (yesterday). We plan to buy one new table to replace the half-table with two broken legs, exchange eight old nets for new ones, and lay anti-slip floor matting on both playing areas. Teacher HUANG Zhigang has already replied that the request is reasonable and feasible, and has told us to contact Teacher ZHAI Sumin, who will be in charge of club administration next term. We will follow the situation closely, work with the school on a concrete plan, and keep you all updated on progress. The improvements may have to be carried out after the start of term, and the playing areas may be out of use for a short while — please bear with any inconvenience this causes!

content_en:
[JIANG Zirun did not look after his paddle properly, and when it turned up again it was badly waterlogged]
The newly appointed Activities Department Head JIANG Zirun lost his paddle on the afternoon of 18 June. On the morning of today (23 June), during the long break, after a 15-minute search, it turned up on a bench beside the running track on the sports field. After the heavy rain, the paddle and its case were thoroughly soaked, and the black-and-red rubber had faded badly, turning grey and pink. Fortunately the paddle still performs well. JIANG Zirun has said he will not replace it for the time being. With that, Vice President REN Anzhe reminds all players to look after their paddles properly

title: 官宣！武外乒乓球社迎来多项变革！（附换届公告）
excerpt: 为进一步提升社团活力与服务质量，在武汉外国语学校乒乓球社完成新老管理层交接之际，全体核心成员齐心协力，计划逐步推出多项重大改革举措。（点击查看详情）
content:
为进一步提升社团活力与服务质量，在武汉外国语学校乒乓球社完成新老管理层交接之际，全体核心成员齐心协力，计划逐步推出多项重大改革举措。

一、全力改善场地与器材条件

受限于现有活动空间，球台数量不足；加之社团扩招，社员人数持续增加。同时，部分器材与场地设施老化、损坏，已影响不少同学的参与感与体验感。尽管目前学校对物资采购及报销管理更加严格，社团管理层仍将尽最大努力，争取改善活动场地与器材条件。

二、正式实施乒乓球个人积分制度

该制度旨在将社员竞技水平数字化、可视化，为后续大赛的种子选手排定及分组提供直接依据。为此，社团将推出排位赛、挑战赛等多项官方认证的小型赛事，主要安排在每周四社团课时间进行。届时，社团将征用体育馆内的2张球台用于正式比赛，确保社团活动规范化开展。征用球台可能给其他同学带来不便，无法上场的社员可前往比赛区域观赛或助威，敬请理解与支持。也希望各球台台主能充分利用好活动场地，进行轮单或轮双，提高球台利用率。

三、启动官网建设项目，推动信息数字化、公开化

在第二项改革及其他因素共同推动下，为更好实现社团信息数字化与公开化，我社已启动官网制作项目。截至目前，项目进展顺利，整体框架已基本完成，仅剩个别细节待调整，已进入最后调试与完善阶段。官网预计于今年6月22日正式对外发布，届时将发布官网专题介绍，敬请期待！

武汉外国语学校乒乓球社团
2026年6月16日
编辑：武汉外国语学校乒乓球社团新任副社长任安喆、前任社团骨干任峻贤
审核：武汉外国语学校乒乓球社团新任社长龚雨煊

乒乓球社换届公告

各位球友、社员伙伴：
大家好！
因任期届满，乒乓球社将于近期完成换届交接。即日起，由新高二（9）班龚雨煊同学为新任乒乓球社社长，新高二（7）班任安喆、新高二（6）班谷子易和新高二（9）班梅哲宇为新任乒乓球社副社长，全面负责社团日常运营与活动组织。
同时，新高二（6）班姜子润担任活动部部长兼器械部部长，新高二（6）班叶孟恒担任宣传部部长，分别负责社团活动组织、器材管理与对外宣传工作。
感谢过去一年每一位伙伴的陪伴与支持，从日常约球到校内赛、联谊交流，每一记挥拍都让我们的社团更有温度。相信在新社长的带领下，乒社会继续打出精彩、拼出热爱。
后续社团相关活动事宜敬请关注群内通知。如有任何建议或想法，欢迎随时私信沟通。
以球会友，未来可期。
球台见！

乒乓球社卸任社长祁子傲
2026年6月16日
title_en: Official Announcement: Major Changes Coming to the WFLS Table Tennis Club! (With the Leadership Handover Notice)
excerpt_en: To further raise the club's energy and service quality, and as the WFLS Table Tennis Club completes its handover from the outgoing to the incoming officers, all core members have united to roll out a series of major reforms step by step. (click for details)
content_en:
To further raise the club's energy and service quality, and as the WFLS Table Tennis Club completes its handover from the outgoing to the incoming officers, all core members have united to roll out a series of major reforms step by step.

I. Doing everything possible to improve the playing area and the equipment

The current activity space is too small, so there are not enough tables; on top of that the club keeps recruiting and membership keeps growing. At the same time, some equipment and court facilities are ageing or damaged, which already spoils the enjoyment of many members. Although the school now applies stricter rules to purchasing supplies and reimbursements, the club officers will still do everything they can to improve the playing area and the equipment.

II. Introducing the official individual points system

The system is designed to make every member's playing level digital and visible, and to give a direct basis for seeding and grouping in future tournaments. To that end the club will run a range of officially certified small events, such as ranking matches and challenge matches, mainly during Thursday club period. For these, the club will reserve two tables in the gymnasium for official matches, so that club activities run in a properly regulated way. Reserving tables may inconvenience other students; members who are not playing are welcome to come and watch or cheer in the match area — please understand and support this. We also ask every table host to make good use of the activity area by rotating through singles and doubles, so that table utilisation stays high.

III. Launching the club website project to make information digital and public

Driven by the second reform and by other factors, and in order to better make the club's information digital and transparent, we have started building the club website. Progress is smooth so far: the overall framework is essentially complete, only a few details remain to be adjusted, and the project has entered its final debugging and polish stage. The website is scheduled to launch publicly on 22 June this year, and a feature introduction will be published at the same time — stay tuned!

WFLS Table Tennis Club
16 June 2026
Edited by: REN Anzhe, incoming Vice President of the WFLS Table Tennis Club, and REN Junxian, former club officer
Reviewed by: GONG Yuxuan, incoming President of the WFLS Table Tennis Club

Table Tennis Club Leadership Handover Announcement

Dear table tennis friends and fellow members,
Hello!
As the current term of office comes to an end, the Table Tennis Club will complete its leadership handover in the coming days. Effective immediately, GONG Yuxuan of New Grade 11 Class 9 takes over as President of the Table Tennis Club, and REN Anzhe of New Gr.11 Class 7, GU Ziyi of New Gr.11 Class 6 and MEI Zheyu of New Gr.11 Class 9 take over as Vice Presidents, jointly responsible for the club's day-to-day operation and activity organisation.
At the same time, JIANG Zirun of New Gr.11 Class 6 takes the posts of Activities Department Head and Equipment Department Head, and YE Mengheng of New Gr.11 Class 6 takes the post of Publicity Department Head — covering club activity organisation, equipment management and external publicity respectively.
Thank you to every member who has been with us over the past year. From casual rallies to school tournaments and friendly exchanges, every swing of the paddle has warmed this club. We are confident that under the new President the club will keep playing brilliantly and playing with passion.
For all upcoming club activities, please watch the notices in the group chat. If you have any suggestions or ideas, feel free to send a private message at any time.
Making friends through the game — there is a bright future ahead.
See you at the tables!

QI Ziao, outgoing President of the Table Tennis Club
16 June 2026

content_en: The final was tense and ran long; with the overall score at 2:2 and the deciding match at 1:1 games, the school gymnasium lights went out on schedule, so the match could not be continued. After joint consultation by both teams, the umpiring crew and the club officers, the two sides were decided as joint champions of this final, while the winner and loser of the bronze-medal match take the runner-up and third places respectively. Congratulations to all four semifinalists! Today's match scores will be posted a little later. In addition, in order to leave everyone enough time to revise for the mid-term exams, all remaining singles fixtures will be played after the exams. Good luck with your exams and with your matches!

title: 2026年武汉外国语学校乒乓球单打比赛赛制说明书
excerpt: 2026年武汉外国语学校乒乓球单打比赛赛制说明书（点击查看详情）
content:
【2026年武汉外国语学校乒乓球单打比赛赛制说明书 】

一、比赛总体结构
本届单打比赛分为两个阶段进行：
第一阶段：小组赛
第二阶段：淘汰赛（正赛）

二、小组赛阶段
1. 分组方式
全体参赛选手共分为 14个小组，每组 4人。
2. 比赛形式
采用单循环赛制，即每位选手需与本组其余三名选手各进行一场比赛。
每组共进行 6场比赛。
3. 比赛规则
* 每场比赛采用 三局两胜制
4. 积分规则
* 胜一场：2分
* 负一场：1分
* 退赛：0分
5. 晋级规则
每组按积分排名，前两名晋级，共计 28人进入淘汰赛阶段。

三、淘汰赛（正赛）阶段
1. 28进14（首轮淘汰赛）
由每组第一名对阵相邻组第二名
示例：
* 第11组第1名 vs 第12组第2名
* 第12组第1名 vs 第11组第2名
本轮胜者共 14人晋级。
2. 14+2进8
本阶段共有 16人参与：
* 小组赛晋级的14人
* 校队内部循环赛产生的 2个直通名额
共计16人进行淘汰赛，决出 8强。
3. 四分之一决赛（8进4）
4. 半决赛（4进2）
5. 决赛（2进1）

四、其他说明
1. 淘汰赛阶段比赛：半决赛和决赛采用七局四胜制，其余均采用五局三胜制
2. 全部比赛均执行国际乒联（ITTF）现行竞赛规则。
title_en: 2026 WFLS Table Tennis Singles — Format and Rules
excerpt_en: 2026 WFLS Table Tennis Singles — Format and Rules (click for details)
content_en:
【2026 WFLS Table Tennis Singles — Format and Rules】

I. Overall structure
This year's singles tournament is played in two stages:
Stage 1: group stage
Stage 2: knockout stage (main draw)

II. Group stage
1. Group composition
All entrants are split into 14 groups of 4.
2. Format
A single round robin is used: each player plays one match against each of the other three players in their group.
Each group plays 6 matches in total.
3. Match rules
* Every match is best of three games
4. Points
* Win: 2 points
* Loss: 1 point
* Withdrawal: 0 points
5. Qualification
Players are ranked on points within each group and the top two advance — 28 players in total reach the knockout stage.

III. Knockout stage (main draw)
1. 28 to 14 (first knockout round)
Each group's first place plays the adjacent group's second place
Example:
* 1st of Group 11 vs 2nd of Group 12
* 1st of Group 12 vs 2nd of Group 11
The 14 winners of this round advance.
2. 14+2 to 8
Sixteen players take part in this stage:
* The 14 qualifiers from the group stage
* 2 direct-entry places from the school team's internal round robin
These 16 players contest a knockout bracket to decide the last eight.
3. Quarter-finals (8 to 4)
4. Semifinals (4 to 2)
5. Final (2 to 1)

IV. Other notes
1. Knockout matches: the semifinals and final are best of seven games; all other matches are best of five games
2. All matches follow the current ITTF competition rules.

参赛队伍：20支团体队伍
判标准：采用国际乒联（ITTF）现行团体赛规则，采用A-X，B-Y，C-Z，A-Y，B-X的顺序，每场五局三胜，大盘五场三胜。

半决赛：4进2（淘汰赛）
决赛：2进1（淘汰赛：将产生冠军队伍与亚军队伍）
title_en: 2026 WFLS Table Tennis Team Event — Format and Rules
excerpt_en: 2026 WFLS Table Tennis Team Event — Format and Rules (click for details)
content_en:
【2026 WFLS Table Tennis Team Event — Format and Rules】

Participating teams: 20 team entries
Match rules: the current ITTF team event rules apply. Ties are played in the order A-X, B-Y, C-Z, A-Y, B-X. Each match is best of five games; each tie is best of five matches.
Round 1: 20 to 12 (knockout)
Round 2: 12 to 6 (knockout)
Round 3: 6 to 3 (knockout: the three surviving teams advance to the semifinals)
Repechage: 3 to 1 (round robin: the three teams eliminated in the "6 to 3" round play a round robin and are ranked on aggregate tie score; the team with the highest aggregate score advances to the semifinals)
Semifinals: 4 to 2 (knockout)
Final: 2 to 1 (knockout: the champion and runner-up teams are decided)
